046746c9-8872-4797-a112-318642fdb272.altTitle: The Delinquent Shimizu-san Sitting Next to Me Has Dyed Her Hair Black
046746c9-8872-4797-a112-318642fdb272.description:
"I dyed my hair black for you... so notice me."

Shimizu-san, the delinquent highschool girl who sits next to Hondo with her newly-dyed hair, gradually lowered her voice, slightly blushed, and laid her face down on the desk. After that, when Daiki Hondo talked with his friend about how he wanted be with a girl who can cook, the next day Hondo ended up partnered with Shimizu-san in cooking class, even though she used to always skip class. When Hondo mentioned that he wished he could try a girl's hand-made cooking, for some reason she brought two bentos to lunch the next day and shared one with Hondo...
___

74ad3ad0-41e2-4919-a3dd-e5061c3444da.title: Futago Matomete "Kanojo" ni Shinai?
74ad3ad0-41e2-4919-a3dd-e5061c3444da.description: Usami is a beautiful classmate with good morals and top grades. At school, she views Sakuto as her rival. But when he bumps into her after school, he sees a different side of her. She was playing at an arcade after classes, and she had this innocent smile that one couldn't imagine on her at school. For the sake of getting along with her, he gets close to her at school and then plays together with her after school. They each have their places where they can deepen their bonds, and at last...

80d288be-bdb9-4637-804e-02b2f89ad2d8.title: Jungle Juice
80d288be-bdb9-4637-804e-02b2f89ad2d8.description:
Jang Suchan is an extraordinary college student at the top of the social food chain. But underneath the perfect façade, he hides a pair of insect wings that suddenly grew when he used a mysterious bug spray called "Jungle Juice.” Suchan's life crumbles when he bares his wings to the world to save someone's life. When all hope seems lost, Suchan stumbles upon a hidden world of insect humans where everyone is accepted for what they are.

But the law of the jungle governs this secret society and all must fend for themselves in order to survive.

43ba30ce-8cdb-4f68-863a-04e6ce7501ef.title: Twilight Poem
43ba30ce-8cdb-4f68-863a-04e6ce7501ef.description: A hidden love story of a ghost princess who never loved anyone. General Jahyeon of Heeran Nation marries Soru, a ‘princess who sees ghosts’ by the king’s order. Jahyeon is cold to Soru, but he has the power to ward off ghosts, hence Soru wants to stay by his side. Soru is willing to sacrifice everything for Jahyeon, who is her only safe haven. Jahyeon is getting more and more concerned about Soru, but…

0422e565-8953-4bda-86a2-9055430ff8cb.altTitle: The Heroines in my Graduation Albums
0422e565-8953-4bda-86a2-9055430ff8cb.description:
"A love that was supposed to be just a memory starts moving all at once!!"

Kanae Meguru, a movie enthusiast, had potential romantic interests throughout elementary, middle, and high school. However, due to his lack of experience in love, he was never able to take action. Learning from that, he vowed to focus entirely on his university film club activities, completely ignoring romance. But that resolve was short-lived—before he knew it, he found himself falling for Ootsuka Sora, a girl he met in the film club...!?

b6f9aaad-6787-460c-bbb8-af9eb7bcc3e0.description: Ketika aku membuka mata, aku menyadari bahwa aku telah menjadi tokoh novel berjudul "Sayap yang Robek"! Kini aku harus menjalani hidup sebagai Sherryl, ibu dari tokoh utama yang terkenal kejam, Cartischel. Untungnya, aku masih punya waktu untuk mengubah masa depan. Aku gemetar memikirkan anakku di masa depan... tapi saat masih bocah begini, Cartischel terlalu lucu dan menggemaskan! Tidak mungkin aku membiarkan anak yang imut ini tumbuh menjadi seseorang yang mengurung dan menyakiti tokoh utama wanita, kan?

71ff2fdb-315f-4c68-b9f3-bdc5713c1d88.title: Taming a Munchkin
71ff2fdb-315f-4c68-b9f3-bdc5713c1d88.description:
She was reborn as the antagonist of a fantasy novel, a child who bears her family’s resentment.

As it stands, her fate is to end up on the guillotine at the hands of the furious villagers!

Kynemeia, for the sake of a comfortable future, plans to gather some Munchkins to govern the fief. However, there’s one problem…

Kynemeia stared blankly at the boy sitting in the underground prison.

“…Why?”

“I got caught.”

She’s on the receiving end of an unwanted obsession from a suspicious mage?!

This is the story of the struggles of a Grand Duke’s daughter who wishes to transform her life

and the Munchkin mage who feigns innocence!

fea6a28a-c41b-4d0d-b2b1-3df2504c9080.title: Black Blizzard
fea6a28a-c41b-4d0d-b2b1-3df2504c9080.description: Created in the late 1950s, BLACK BLIZZARD is Yoshihiro Tatsumi's remarkable first full-length tankobon and one of the first published examples of Gekiga. With BLACK BLIZZARD, Tatsumi explores the dark underbelly of his working-class heroes that five decades later will make him one of the most well known Japanese cartoonists in North America. Susumu Yamaji, a 24-year-old pianist, is arrested for murder and ends up handcuffed to a career criminal on the train that will take them to prison. An avalanche derails the train and the criminal takes the opportunity to escape, dragging a reluctant Susumu with him into the blizzard raging outside. They flee into the mountains to an abandoned ranger station, where they take shelter from the storm. As they sit around the fire they built, Susumu relates how love drove him to become a murderer.

512cd78f-cbb8-460a-bafd-e8840c0f7c31.title: Sword Art Online: Unital Ring
512cd78f-cbb8-460a-bafd-e8840c0f7c31.description:
Orchestrated by genius scientist Akihiko Kayaba, the SAO Incident created a game you couldn't leave until you beat it.
One where death in the game meant death in the real world... Kirito is a survivor of SAO who now spends his time playing the new VRMMORPG Alfheim Online with his old SAO friends, Asuna and Alice.
But Kirito soon finds himself caught up in a mysterious game he never expected...

(Source: Yen Press)
